scope: Bounded factual review of the final visible article and held suggestions against primary GitHub records and pinned repository sources; no article revision or acceptance, finding disposition, action admission or settlement, readiness or merge, workflow dispatch, runtime or schedule change.

findings.title: The post-founding cascade had eight open PRs, not twelve
findings.location: The title, summary and line 11 say a twelve-PR cascade existed by the interval end; lines 46–48 identify it as PRs #44–#52.
findings.explanation: The complete repository pull-request inventory through the interval cutoff contains merged founding PR #1 and eight open follow-ons: #44, #46, #47, #48, #49, #50, #51 and #52. Number 45 is an issue, not a PR.
findings.correction: Call this an eight-PR follow-on cascade and adjust the title, summary, opening and decision heading accordingly.

findings.title: The independent review was an OpenAI Codex model review, not a human audit
findings.location: Line 50 says the independent review is a human audit pass.
findings.explanation: The PR #1 review submission identifies itself as an independent review by OpenAI Codex. It was carried by the shared ojfbot account; neither the login nor model separation authenticates a human reviewer.
findings.correction: Describe the numbered list as an OpenAI Codex independent model review; do not authenticate a human reviewer from the shared GitHub account or model-to-model separation.

findings.title: PR #46 has an explicit owner-only merge gate
findings.location: Lines 36 and 95 say no owner gate or blocker is recorded; the first held candidate at line 110 commands an immediate rebase merge.
findings.explanation: PR #46 says doctor.py is owner-merge. HouseholdAgentKit AGENTS.md says doctor checks wait for the owner and are never merged by an agent, while noting that the owner and agents share one GitHub identity.
findings.correction: Retain the explicit owner merge decision and different-agent review gate. Replace the immediate merge command with a supervised owner review and decision checkpoint.

findings.title: Issues #39, #40 and #42 do not all have P0 priority
findings.location: Lines 54 and 74 and the retained context at line 111 call all three P0 issues.
findings.explanation: Issue #39 is labeled P0, #40 is P1 and #42 is P2. Their gates also differ: #39 gates live beat #20, #40 gates rung 10 and #42 explicitly gates no rung.
findings.correction: Report the recorded P0, P1 and P2 priorities and their distinct gates instead of grouping all three as P0.

findings.title: Rung 3 waits on #38 and #41 C1/C2, not every #41 item or Q-RV-1
findings.location: Lines 72–74 and the third held candidate at line 110 make all C1–C5, including Q-RV-1 for C3, rung-3 prerequisites.
findings.explanation: Issue #41 explicitly says C1 and C2 come before rung 3 and repeats that rung 3 does not start before C1 and C2 are done. Q-RV-1 is assigned to the owner as the C3 decision; C4 and C5 are not named as rung-3 prerequisites. Issue #38 separately gates rung 3 on its doctor findings.
findings.correction: Name #38 plus #41 C1 and C2 as the recorded rung-3 prerequisites. Keep Q-RV-1 as the owner decision for C3 without inflating it into the sole rung-3 unblocker or calling it unowned.

findings.title: The doctor stack's finding map is not findings 1–10 followed by smoke and console
findings.location: Line 50 says #48 through #51 cover the findings in order as findings 1–10, then smoke and console, then 11–16, then 18–21.
findings.explanation: PR #48 is finding 4's date and known-hole half; #49 is findings 3 and 8; #50 is findings 11–16; #51 is findings 18–21; and independent #52 supplies finding 4's engine half. The PR bodies do not assign findings 1–10 to #48.
findings.correction: Use the exact recorded mapping and keep #52's independent second half of finding 4 visible; do not invent a sequential 1–10 block.

findings.title: Only the legacy telemetry stream is frozen; the collector's primary source is live
findings.location: Line 78 says the telemetry stream has been frozen since 2026-05-12; the fifth held candidate at line 110 proposes replacing or deprecating the skill telemetry stream on that premise.
findings.explanation: The pinned collector makes skill-dispositions.jsonl the live primary source and uses frozen skill-telemetry.jsonl only as a legacy fallback. It records the selected source and newest timestamp and gives that provenance to the drafting model.
findings.correction: Distinguish the live dispositions ledger from the frozen legacy fallback and report the captured source and freshness; inspect those fields before proposing instrument replacement.
